subject.title: Sub-agent timeout recovery creates duplicate API posts (idempotency gap)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core durable logical-action idempotency and replay contract for sub-agent/tool side effects, and where should that identity boundary live?
rationale: The remaining gap crosses agent, gateway, and tool semantics; choosing the wrong boundary could either duplicate external actions or suppress legitimate repeated actions.

options.title: Design a narrow core contract
options.body: Define logical action identity, payload digest, expiry, replay, and audit behavior first, then implement the smallest core/gateway change that protects sub-agent retries.

options.title: Keep exact-key idempotency as the core boundary
options.body: Treat the shipped message-tool and gateway exact-key behavior as the supported core guarantee and leave broader external API idempotency to workflows or plugins.

options.title: Route this to ClawHub guidance
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core unchanged and direct unattended multi-agent operators to service-specific idempotency keys and ClawHub workflow skills.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Define logical action identity, payload digest, expiry, replay, and audit behavior first, then implement the smallest core/gateway change that protects sub-agent retries.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting agent/gateway product contract, and steipete has the strongest history signal across those paths.
